questions.text: Who created the Laravel framework?
questions.explanation: Laravel was created by Taylor Otwell.

questions.text: In what year was Laravel created?
questions.explanation: Laravel was created in 2011.

questions.text: Laravel follows which architectural pattern?
questions.explanation: Laravel follows the MVC architectural pattern.

questions.text: Laravel is a framework for which programming language?
questions.explanation: Laravel is an open-source PHP web application framework.

questions.text: Which templating engine is built into Laravel?
questions.explanation: Blade is Laravel's built-in templating engine.

questions.text: Which Laravel feature lets developers write database queries using PHP syntax instead of raw SQL?
questions.explanation: Eloquent ORM (Object Relational Mapping) lets you query using PHP syntax.

questions.text: Which built-in Laravel tool is used for command-line automation tasks?
questions.explanation: Artisan is Laravel's CLI for automation.

questions.text: Per the module, what is the minimum PHP version required to start a Laravel project?
questions.explanation: The listed prerequisite is PHP >= 8.1.

questions.text: Which tool is described as "at the foundation of most modern PHP development," used to install Laravel and manage dependencies?
questions.explanation: Composer installs Laravel, updates it, and brings in external dependencies.

questions.text: Which command correctly creates a new Laravel project using Composer's create-project feature?
questions.explanation: composer create-project laravel/laravel projectName creates a new project subdirectory.

questions.text: In MVC, which component interacts directly with the database?
questions.explanation: The Model interacts with the database.

questions.text: In MVC, which component contains everything the user can see on screen?
questions.explanation: The View is the user interface.

questions.text: Which MVC component is described as the "heart of the application," connecting the Model and View?
questions.explanation: The Controller contains the business logic and connects Model and View.

questions.text: Which Laravel directory contains index.php (the entry point for every request) plus images, JS, and CSS assets?
questions.explanation: The public/ directory holds index.php and public assets.

questions.text: The ___ directory contains all of your application's configuration files.
questions.explanation: config/ holds all configuration files.

questions.text: The ___ directory contains your database migrations, model factories, and seeders.
questions.explanation: database/ holds migrations, factories, and seeders.

questions.text: Complete the command to install the Laravel installer tool globally with Composer:
questions.explanation: composer global require "laravel/installer" installs the Laravel installer tool.

questions.text: Complete the command to create a new project using the Laravel installer tool:
questions.explanation: laravel new projectName creates a fresh Laravel project.
